name: Szkolny
tagline: Check your Polish school grades and timetable in one place
description:
Szkolny is an unofficial app that brings together the most popular Polish school gradebook systems, like Librus, Vulcan, Mobidziennik and iDziennik, into a single easy-to-use app. Instead of juggling several separate logins and apps, students and parents can check grades, schedules and announcements in one place.

It is community-built and free, and it has been actively maintained for years by developers who wanted a better experience than the official apps offer.
